Decentralized Data and Verification Infrastructure

Built on the Solana blockchain, UpRock is a decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) network that provides verifiable web data for AI systems. The platform aims to turn the raw data required for AI agents and automation systems to analyze the real state of the internet into a reliable layer. Users provide data to the network by sharing their idle internet bandwidth through the relevant app and are rewarded in UPT tokens in return.

Today, the network operates on more than 3 million real devices based on Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android in more than 190 countries. This distributed architecture enables internet data to be obtained not only from centralized data centers but directly from end-user devices, creating the “Ground Truth” (Verified Reality) concept.

Data Optimization for AI

The UpRock.ai platform converts data collected from the internet into structured formats that large language models (LLM) and AI agents can consume directly. The platform’s infrastructure consists of three core layers:

  • Insight Stacks: The data layer that enables developers to integrate live web data into applications through API calls or simple commands.
  • AI Sitemaps: Creates next-generation sitemaps based on LLMs.txt for websites. This technology reduces costs and increases data retrieval speed by optimizing the amount of tokens AI systems use while crawling websites.
  • UpRock Verify: The security layer that enables content and services on the internet to be verified simultaneously through devices on the global network.

Revenue Sharing and Future Goals

The venture, which received $4 million in investment at an early stage, serves enterprise customers and developers with a usage-based SaaS model. Under the token economy created in the system, 40% of the revenue generated from the infrastructure fees paid by businesses is redistributed to the hardware owners who enable data production. UpRock’s long-term goal is to solve the hallucination (false information generation) problem in AI systems and create a reliable data ecosystem in which every piece of information on the internet is verified at the device level.
